api:__potatoAtlasSelection.rationale: Country selection deliberately wraps and replaces the core selection API while retaining compatibility for downstream modules.

api:__potatoAtlasCapitals.rationale: Places owns capitals when production place data is healthy; hover provides the bounded fallback capitals API otherwise.

url:country.rationale: The core renderer remains the low-level country URL writer while the browse-first selection controller wraps it and persists the canonical working selection.

url:compare.rationale: The core renderer retains compare compatibility while the browse-first selection controller clears or preserves compare state during working-selection persistence.

url:lens.rationale: The composable layer registry migrates and clears the legacy Lens URL state while the dormant compatibility Lens module retains the old writer.

url:lensOption.rationale: The composable layer registry migrates and clears the legacy Lens option while the dormant compatibility Lens module retains the old writer.

allowed_modules.world-map/3d-render-stack.js: Canonical semantic z-order reconciliation after style changes; deferred and idempotent through its schedule() microtask.
allowed_modules.world-map/3d-physical-water.js: Restores optional Natural Earth water resources only while Water is enabled, with restoring guard and microtask deferral.
allowed_modules.world-map/3d-physical-land-cover.js: Restores the optional ESA WorldCover source/layer only while enabled, with restoring guard and microtask deferral.
allowed_modules.world-map/3d-physical-deserts.js: Restores the optional desert/xeric context only while enabled, with restoring guard and microtask deferral.
allowed_modules.world-map/3d-physical-hydrology.js: Restores bounded hydrology sources/layers only while enabled, with restoring guard and microtask deferral.
